changelog: v0.6.4: 1) Persistent Antigravity Session Bridge: bidirectional sync with official on-disk Antigravity transcript (transcript.jsonl), voice chats store, conversation database, and presence lock; 2) Antigravity IDE Visibility: sessions are now identifiable, selectable, and interactable directly from external Antigravity UIs, sidecars, and IDE panels; 3) Zero-latency memory persistence: continuous fact recall and arithmetic chaining seamlessly synced across restarts.
